title: Operator defers or discards recorded findings
asA: operator who has decided not to submit some findings
iWant: to mark the pending batch deferred for this session, or discard specific entries entirely, without any network activity
soThat: a "not now" or "never for this one" answer is honoured immediately and the state is durable across the next boot

acceptanceCriteria.description: rcf feedback defer appends a state line for every currently pending entry stamping status: deferredUntilSession with the current sessionId; the entries stay in the log so the next session sees them; the current session-end hook does not re-ask. Exit 0. Nothing is sent.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture project with two pending entries and a known sessionId
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator runs rcf feedback defer
acceptanceCriteria.then: entries.jsonl grows by two lines each carrying the deferred status and sessionId; a folded read shows both entries at status deferredUntilSession; no network call was made

acceptanceCriteria.description: rcf feedback discard <id> marks only the named entries discarded (kept in the log for 30 days, then pruned on the next add). --all discards every pending entry. Discarded entries are excluded from list default output, hidden from the SessionStart carry-over count, and never appear in a submit or bundle. Exit 0.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture project with three pending entries
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator runs rcf feedback discard fb-<a> fb-<b> then rcf feedback list
acceptanceCriteria.then: the two named entries are folded to status discarded; list shows only the remaining entry; the next add older than 30 days prunes them
